user.title: Officiële Bekendmakingen
user.description: Follow official publications around a zone.

data_description.zone: Publications are measured from the centre of this zone.

data_description.days: How many days of publications to fetch.

authorities.title: Authorities

data_description.summary_language: Language the summaries are written in. Existing summaries in another language are rewritten.
